 Jaydev Unadkat Is the Most Sold Player in IPL History, Bought 13 Times Across 15 Seasons
 Jaydev Unadkat has been bought 13 times in IPL auctions, more than any other player in the history of the tournament. The left-arm pacer has been sold at 13 auctions across 15 seasons, a record that …
 Published By : 
 Sports Desk , Mumbai 
 Last Updated: November 13, 2026, 10:07 IST 
 Jaydev Unadkat, Nathan Coulter-Nile and Mohit Sharma. Unadkat has been bought 13 times in IPL auctions, almost twice as often as anyone else. 
 Jaydev Unadkat has been bought 13 times in IPL auctions, more than any other player in the history of the tournament. The left-arm pacer has been sold at 13 auctions across 15 seasons, a record that no one else comes close to matching.
 Thirteen sales, eight franchises
 Unadkat's auction journey began in 2011, when Kolkata Knight Riders bought him for Rs 1.13 crore. Royal Challengers Bengaluru picked him up in 2013 for Rs 2.79 crore, and Delhi bought him in 2014 for Rs 2.8 crore and again in 2015 for Rs 1.1 crore.
 He returned to Kolkata in 2016 for Rs 1.6 crore, then moved to Rising Pune Supergiant in 2017 for Rs 30 lakh. Rajasthan Royals bought him in 2018, 2019 and 2020, and he has since played for Mumbai Indians in 2022, Lucknow Super Giants in 2023, and Sunrisers Hyderabad in 2024 and 2025.
 Eight franchises, 13 sales, and a career that has spanned the full history of the league. Few players have been wanted by so many teams, so many times.
 The Rs 11.5 crore peak
 The high point of Unadkat's auction career came in 2018, when Rajasthan Royals paid Rs 11.5 crore for him. It was a fee that reflected his form at the time and the premium that franchises place on left-arm pace.
 Rajasthan kept him for two more seasons, paying Rs 8.4 crore in 2019 and Rs 3 crore in 2020. His other notable sales include Rs 2.8 crore from Delhi in 2014, Rs 2.79 crore from Bengaluru in 2013, Rs 1.6 crore from Kolkata in 2016 and from Hyderabad in 2024, and Rs 1.3 crore from Mumbai in 2022.
 No one else comes close
 The next players on the list have been sold seven times each: Nathan Coulter-Nile, Mohit Sharma and Amit Mishra. Pat Cummins follows with six sales. Unadkat's 13 is almost double the tally of anyone else in IPL history.
 There is a reason teams keep coming back for him. Left-arm pacers who can swing the new ball and bowl at the death are always in demand, and Unadkat has built a career on being the reliable option that franchises reach for year after year.
 With the IPL 2027 auction scheduled for December 16, the question is whether Unadkat will add a 14th sale to his record. On the evidence of 15 seasons, it would be a surprise if nobody came calling.
